title: A narrow interval misses
hook: Two stated cases: explore the realized miss count behind a confidence claim.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the realized miss count behind a confidence claim affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Misses, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the realized miss count behind a confidence claim in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy interval procedure claims coverage 0.98; it covers 60 of 100 targets. How many targets were missed?
